thread:
mike: Heads up — runtime change in PR #4721 alters header-preservation behavior. Router needs a quick compatibility pin.
sara: thanks, what's the exposure? are console routes affected?
mike: console may see 1-2% 500s on rare sharded paths, low volume but reproducible in staging.
jen: API team saw similar in canary: downstream requests to router lost x-forwarded-for header on retries.
ryan: timeline? we have a quiet window at 02:00-04:00 UTC. prefer to roll after that unless urgent.
mike: I'd like to roll runtime at 01:30 and hold router on previous variant until we validate console/end-to-end.
sara: agree. can we pin router to v1.9.2 and then unpin after validation? @sara can you coordinate console checks?
deploy-bot: /pin service=router version=v1.9.2 until=1749999900  -- pinned by ryan (reason: runtime header change, validation hold)
mike: thanks. i'll deploy runtime v2.3.1-canary -> stable at 01:30 UTC. will post canary metrics.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime v2.3.1 -> stable at 2025-03-15T01:30:00Z. Notifying oncall.
jen: add rollback criteria: if 95p latency increases >200ms or error-rate >1% sustained 5m, rollback runtime.
ryan: agreed. update release notes and pin entry.
sara: console will run e2e smoke and auth path checks at +5m, +20m, +45m post-deploy.
mike: quick commands I'm running in staging:
```
kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:v2.3.1-canary
watch -n 5 curl -sS staging-console.local/health | jq .
```
jen: noted. tagging owners: @sara for console, @jen for api, @mike for runtime. I'll add to release-notes:
- runtime v2.3.1: header preservation fix
- router pinned v1.9.2 until post-validation
- rollback triggers: 95p latency +200ms or error-rate >1% 5m
ryan: also adding: "manual quick rollback window: use /rollback runtime to v2.3.0 if triggers hit".
mike: will monitor metrics and flame graphs, will call rollback if thresholds hit.
sara: I'll run smoke now in staging to get a baseline.
ops-bot: Baseline metrics captured for console: 95p=420ms, error-rate=0.12%
jen: can we also capture router tail latencies? need to know impact of header changes.
mike: capturing. pushing small traffic to canary now.
deploy-bot: Wave scheduled: runtime rollout started. Canary 10% -> 100% in 30m unless halted.
ryan: okay. team, if anything odd ping #eng-oncall and mark thread with :triangular_flag_on_post:.
mike: thanks. i'll post status updates every 10m during rollout.
sara: ack, will validate console smoke at +5m and +20m and report.
mike: update +12m: canary at 40%, no client errors so far, 95p down 10ms.
jen: api traces look fine. no header-related retries.
ops-bot: metric watch: error-rate spike 0.9% -> still under threshold.
mike: +35m: rollout complete. starting validation window.
sara: smoke +5m: passed. smoke +20m: passed. all paths good.
jen: API checks OK. router pin can be removed after +60m if no regressions.
ryan: propose unpin at 03:10 UTC (after validation window). any objections?
mike: none from runtime.
sara: none from console.
deploy-bot: /unpin service=router version=v1.9.2 -- scheduled at 1749999900 (03:10 UTC)
ops-bot: Unpin executed. Router now accepting new variants.
ryan: closing release note draft and marking release complete. thumbs up everyone :thumbsup:
mike: great, thanks all. will open a follow-up PR to document header test in e2e-suite.
jen: noted, will add api integration test.
sara: adding console smoke to baseline pipeline.
ryan: marking thread resolved. good job.
